argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$bootstrap='E:\WebAIBridge-R69-OBSERVABILITY-20261014-GPT6\app\r69-viewer-bootstrap.js'
$a=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 17450 -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop|Select-Object -First 1
$before=$a.OwningProcess
$x=& node.exe $bootstrap --start
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'R69_BOOTSTRAP_NOT_HEALTHY'}
$j=$x|Out-String|ConvertFrom-Json
$after=(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 17450 -State Listen|Select-Object -First 1).OwningProcess
$live1=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17450/api/live' -TimeoutSec 3
$live2=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17450/api/live' -TimeoutSec 3
Write-Output ('BOOTSTRAP_STATUS='+$j.state)
Write-Output ('BOOTSTRAP_DUPLICATE_STARTED='+$j.started)
Write-Output ('SAME_PID='+($before -eq $after))
Write-Output ('API_TIMESTAMP_CHANGED='+($live1.checkedAt -ne $live2.checkedAt))
Write-Output ('NO_PROVIDER_SEND='+($live2.guardrails.noSend -eq $true))
Write-Output ('MONITOR_UNREGISTERED='+$live2.unregisteredOpenCount)
Write-Output ('MONITOR_ASSIGNMENTS='+@($live2.assignments).Count)
$w=New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
$link=Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')) 'WebAIBridge-R69-Live.lnk'
$shortcut=$w.CreateShortcut($link)
Write-Output ('STARTUP_LINK_VALID='+($shortcut.Arguments -match 'r69-viewer-bootstrap.js'))
if($j.started -ne $false -or $before -ne $after){throw 'BOOTSTRAP_DUPLICATED_RUNNING_VIEWER'}

note: Validate installed startup shortcut and idempotent one-shot node bootstrap while existing R68 observer runs; read-only effect on processes.
